title: CLASP: Complementary Layer Selection and Profiling for Zero-Shot OOD Detection using Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28986v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable zero-shot out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in medical imaging, yet existing approaches often rely on final-layer confidence or entropy-based layer selection, potentially missing complementary information. We show that low in-distribution (ID) confidence entropy does not reliably predict OOD discrimination. We introduce CLASP (Complementary Layer Selection and Profiling), an ID-only framework that jointly models layer--prompt responses and visual features. CLASP ranks visual encoder layers using Gaussian conditional mutual information and selects a compact subset through anchored spectral selection, without fixing the number of layers. It then combines the selected layer--prompt profiles with PCA-compressed visual embeddings and fits a single shrinkage-regularized Gaussian. OOD scores are computed using squared Mahalanobis distance, without fine-tuning, OOD training data, or test-time adaptation.

translated_title: CLASP：基于视觉语言模型的零样本分布外检测的互补层选择与剖析
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）能够实现医学影像中的零样本分布外（OOD）检测，然而现有方法通常依赖于最终层置信度或基于熵的层选择，可能遗漏互补信息。我们证明，低的分布内（ID）置信度熵并不能可靠地预测OOD判别能力。我们提出了CLASP（互补层选择与剖析），这是一个仅使用分布内数据的框架，联合建模层-提示响应与视觉特征。CLASP利用高斯条件互信息对视觉编码器各层进行排序，并通过锚定谱选择方法选出一个紧凑的子集，且无需预先固定层数。随后，它将选定的层-提示特征与经PCA压缩的视觉嵌入相结合，并拟合一个单一的正则化收缩高斯模型。OOD分数通过平方马氏距离计算，整个过程无需微调、无需OOD训练数据，也无需测试时自适应。
tldr: 提出仅使用分布内数据的CLASP框架，通过高斯条件互信息与锚定谱选择互补地挑选视觉编码器层与提示组合，并结合PCA压缩的视觉特征以马氏距离计算OOD分数，实现无需微调的零样本分布外检测。
en_tdlr: CLASP is an ID-only zero-shot OOD detection framework that ranks and complementarily selects VLM visual encoder layers via Gaussian conditional mutual information and anchored spectral selection, then combines layer-prompt profiles with PCA-compressed visual embeddings and squared Mahalanobis distance scoring without fine-tuning, OOD training data, or test-time adaptation.
